Summary:

There's plenty of entertaining space inside and outside this home making it perfect for large groups. The rooftop patio is perfect for events with endless gorgeous views!!

The Space:

Bold and Boujee, Home Features:

• 5 Bedroom, 5.5 Bath - Available for up to 14 Guests!

• Rooftop Patio: Exterior Dining, Seating w/ Tabletop Firepit, & Ping Pong Table

• Private Hot Tub on Roof & Community Pool Access

• Free WiFi & Smart TVs, Complimentary Golf Cart Upon Request*



*Winter "Snowbird" rates available. Message for priority pricing.

*Available for events, fee applies.



Welcome to Bold and Boujee! This brand new build was designed with luxury and amenities in mind to present the best quality and experience possible for your families vacation!

Boasting an incredible 1,000sqft rooftop deck with Panoramic beach views, a hot tub and entertainment area this home checks off every box you want in a true luxury vacation.  After a day playing at the beach come back and enjoy the warm hot tub for an incredible sunset with sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and surrounding 30a areas.



Located perfectly in Inlet Beach just a few steps from Donut Hole and many other dining and shopping areas at Avenue 30a.  You're just a short walk or ride to the beach access and Rosemary Beach. You're also just a 10 minute drive to Pier Park and many other Panama City Beach attractions and entertainment.

Guest Access:

We offer convenient door codes for self-check-in. 850 Vacations by Portoro uses convenient keyless entry for self check-in, details provided 2 weeks (or less) prior to arrival by email and text message.



• Early check-ins or late check-outs: If the property happens to be ready earlier than the standard 4 pm check-in time on the day of your arrival, in most cases an early arrival option may be available when confirmed with the main office. Late check-outs must be confirmed with main office staff prior to the date of departure.



Available for Events (See Other Things to Note for fees/terms.)

- Weddings

- Reunions

- Corporate Functions

- Multiple Family Gatherings



Included Golf Cart Guidelines and Use

- A golf cart is available at the property for guest use by the homeowner. You agree to complete a waiver document regarding the use and liability of the included golf cart which will be issued to you by email/text to be completed by esignature prior to the release of the cart access activation code.



The Neighborhood:

South Walton County's Santa Rosa Beach is located along Florida's Northwest Coast, just east of Destin. One of the oldest 30A coastal towns. You'll enjoy gorgeous state parks, delicious restaurants, and a thriving region for artists. Out of the water? Parks, museums, local galleries, and family-friendly adventures await! With fishing, scuba diving, snorkeling and sand castles, Santa Rosa Beach is the ultimate 30A beach vacation experience!



Things to See:

• Local Experiences:

• Local Restaurants & Shopping

- Restaurants: Bud and Alley's Waterfront Restaurant and Rooftop Bar, Hooked Sea to Table, Down Island Gulf Seafood Restaurant, Louis Louis, The Bay

- Shops: The District, Retail Therapy of Santa Rosa Beach, Uptown Grayton, Gulf Place Town Center, Seagrove Plaza & more!



Annual Festivals & Events:

• The Big Chill on 30a

• 30A Songwriters Festival

• Sandestin Gumbo Festival

• South Walton Beaches Wine & Food Festival

• WaterColor Film Festival

• Harvest Wine and Food Festival

• Fourth of July on 30A

• Gulf Coast Jam



We provide a full list of Things to Do & See and local Restaurants & Shops to experience for our guests including in a personalized Guest Manual in your check-in details provided prior to your stay!

Getting Around:

You'll find that Santa Rosa Beach provides easy access to dining, shopping, and nightlife entertainment. Guests have access to several beaches in the region! Bikes/Cycling or taking public transportation are alternate options (Major corridors in close proximity to South Walton include: I-65, I-55, I-10, and US Hwy 331). While you may be traveling by your/rental vehicle, if you need additional transportation or nearest airport information, we have you covered!



Traveling to/around Inlet Beach, Florida:

• Taxi Cabs [i.e., Panhandle Transportation Group, Miramar Beach Shuttle, Marcowhale Limo Shuttle and Tax Service]

• Uber, Lyft

• Bike/Cycling [Rentals: Coastal Cruisers, Fun Pug Bike Rentals, Runaway Rentals, Sweet Escape Rentals]



Airports:

• Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS) [35 miles north-northwest of downtown Destin]

• Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport (ECP) [35 miles east of Destin]



Popular Landmarks:

• Grayton Beach State Park

• Topsail Hill Preserve State Park

• Shell Island

• Fort Walton Heritage Park and Cultural Center

• Deer Lake State Park

• Seaside Beach



Interaction with Guests:

Our goal is that your vacation exceed your expectations. 850 Vacations by Portoro communicates via email and phone. After a booking is confirmed, rental agreement will be emailed to the guest for e-signature. Check-in instructions are sent by email and text message 14 days (or less) prior to arrival date. We offer convenient keyless entry for self-check in. We do typically check in with guests by text 1-2 times during their stays to ensure a 5-star experience and remain available for any questions. We are available to guests 24/7 for any inquiries.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Loved the place. Was great for our work getaway. Tucked away in a new area and still felt new too. Right next to the community pool and was never overcrowded. Super close to the beach as well, short walk and was a beach entry that had limited parking so wasn’t crazy and overpopulated, but could walk a short distance to find a crowd. Came for 4th of July and always had a home base to go back to away from crowds. Hosts were great and assisted with anything we needed. Highly recommend it if you want a little privacy and a beautiful place to relax away from the beach.
